method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (s 28 (3) access to an insurer's data, three ways joined by ROR, no deadline in the Act) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Discrimination Act 1991 (ACT), A1991-81, Republication No 54 (R54), effective 23 February 2026, last amended by A2026-4, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1991-81.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) Australian Capital Territory, used under CC BY 4.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the individual discriminated against, sexually harassed, vilified or victimised: the job applicant or employee, contract worker or commission agent, partner, member, student, customer, occupier, club member, sportsperson, or person dealing with an ACT public authority, considering a complaint (disc-claims.l4)
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: protected attributes and the meaning of discrimination, the areas where it is unlawful, the exceptions the other side may rely on, sexual harassment, vilification, victimisation, advertising, liability for representatives and helpers, reasonable adjustments and the positive duty, exemptions

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run disc-dates.l4 ; l4 run disc-claims.l4 ; l4 run disc-cases.l4
checks.result: 180 assertions written, 180 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read (each printed twice; distinct ranges counted). Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: ss 4A, 5AA, 5B (as glosses); Part 2 whole (ss 7, 8); Part 3 whole (ss 10-23C); Part 4 whole as a screen of all 42 exceptions by area and ground, with ss 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 (2), 28 (3), 32, 33B, 33C, 41, 46, 51 (2), 52, 53, 54, 57, 57B, 57M worked from facts and s 30 in the put-together question; Part 5 whole (ss 58-67); Part 7 whole (ss 67A, 68, 69); Part 8 whole (ss 70-73); Part 9 whole (ss 74-76); s 109 (what an exemption covers); s 121A; the dictionary. Out: ss 1-4AA, 5A, 5AB, 6, 6A, the remaining Part 4 exceptions one by one (single judgments; in the screen), s 109 application and s 110 review, ss 121-123; the complaint procedure and time limits (Human Rights Commission Act 2005). Reasons in NOTES.md.

subjects/au/act/act-civil-and-administrative-tribunal-act-2008 (ACAT hearing of a referred complaint; review of exemption decisions, s 110)
